title: Interesting design.
text: Interesting design.. I give this 3.5 stars. Sure, it’s a futon, but to access that use, you physically need to turn the seat upside down and flip the down. It’s cumbersome and for anyone who is physically challenged, forget it! The bottom has a zippered panel that must be left unzipped when the legs are down. So there’s an unsightly black flappy material under the chair. The back of the chair is black material so you have to have this against a wall or it’s a 2-toned design. It’s only about 8 inches off the green when used as a chair so anyone with knee issues will be challenged to get in and out. As an actual chair, it’s fine. I tend to like former chairs and sofas. It’s firm! And the padding is thin. Overall, it seems best used as a “sometimes”’chair and an emergency futon. You wouldn’t want the pain and hassle of switching this thing nightly.
